32161-tangle-hold.title: Tangle Hold
32161-tangle-hold.creator: F. L. Wallace
32161-tangle-hold.description: A book by F. L. Wallace. There was an odor in the room, but this time it was the kind that lingers in all hospitals. He tried to sit up, but that was more than he could manage. He lay there a long time, looking through the heavily reinforced window; then someone came in.

56082-dream-songs-for-the-belove-d.title: For The Belovèd
56082-dream-songs-for-the-belove-d.creator: Eleanor Farjeon
56082-dream-songs-for-the-belove-d.description: A book by Eleanor Farjeon. They said it was a fire-land, a land of flaming passions,  The sun like a molten rose in burning sapphire skies,  And never sound nor stir save of hearts that beat their way there  Like southron birds whose wings seek the blue of burning skies.

arxiv-2102-00275.title: Edge states for second order elliptic operators in a channel
arxiv-2102-00275.creator: David Gontier
arxiv-2102-00275.description: Abstract . We present a general framework to study edge states for second order elliptic operators in a half channel. We associate an integer valued index to some bulk materials, and we prove that for any junction between two such materials, localised states must appear at the boundary whenever the indices differ. © 2022 by the author.

arxiv-2104-07805.title: The fast non-ferric kicker system for the Muon g − 2 g-2 Experiment at Fermilab
arxiv-2104-07805.creator: A.P. Schreckenberger 1,, D. Allspach, D. Barak, J. Bohn, C. Bradford, D. Cauz, S. P. Chang, A. Chapelain, S. Chappa, S. Charity, R. Chislett, J. Esquivel, C. Ferrari, A. Fioretti, C. Gabbanini, M. D. Galati, L. Gibbons, J. L. Holzbauer, M. Incagli, C. Jensen, J. Kaspar, D. Kawall, A. Keshavarzi, D.
arxiv-2104-07805.description: Abstract We describe the installation, commissioning, and characterization of the new injection kicker system in the Muon g − 2 g-2 Experiment (E989) at Fermilab, which makes a precision measurement of the muon magnetic anomaly. Three Blumlein pulsers drive each of the 1.27-m-long non-ferric kicker magnets, which reside in a storage ring vacuum (SRV) that is subjected to a 1.

arxiv-2111-09665.title: A Case Study on Optimization of Platooning Coordination
arxiv-2111-09665.creator: Veronika Lesch, Marius Hadry, Samuel Kounev, Christian Krupitzer
arxiv-2111-09665.description: Abstract In today’s world, circumstances, processes, and requirements for software systems are becoming increasingly complex. In order to operate properly in such dynamic environments, software systems must adapt to these changes, which has led to the research area of Self-Adaptive Systems (SAS).

arxiv-2202-00661.title: When Do Flat Minima Optimizers Work?
arxiv-2202-00661.creator: Jean KaddourCentre for Artificial IntelligenceUniversity College London, Linqing LiuCentre for Artificial IntelligenceUniversity College LondonRicardo SilvaDepartment of Statistical ScienceUniversity College LondonMatt J. KusnerCentre for Artificial IntelligenceUniversity College London
arxiv-2202-00661.description: Abstract Recently, flat-minima optimizers , which seek to find parameters in low-loss neighborhoods, have been shown to improve a neural network’s generalization performance over stochastic and adaptive gradient-based optimizers. Two methods have received significant attention due to their scalability: 1. Stochastic Weight Averaging (SWA), and 2. Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM).

arxiv-2204-10617.title: Torsion codimension 2 2 cycles on supersingular abelian varieties
arxiv-2204-10617.creator: Oliver Gregory
arxiv-2204-10617.description: Abstract . We prove that torsion codimension 2 2 algebraic cycles modulo rational equivalence on supersingular abelian varieties are algebraically equivalent to zero. As a consequence, we prove that homological equivalence coincides with algebraic equivalence for algebraic cycles of codimension 2 2 on supersingular abelian varieties over the algebraic closure of finite fields. 1.

arxiv-2305-12884.title: Singlet quantum phases and magnetization of the frustrated spin-1/2 ladder with ferromagnetic (F) exchange in legs and alternating F-AF exchange in rungs
arxiv-2305-12884.creator: Monalisa Chatterjee, Manoranjan Kumar, Zoltán G. Soos
arxiv-2305-12884.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Monalisa Chatterjee, Manoranjan Kumar, Zoltán G. Soos. The magnetization M ⁡ ( h ) M(h) is used to identify three singlet quantum phases of the ladder with isotropic exchange interactions. The Dimer phase with frustrated F exchanges in rungs and legs has a first-order M ⁡ ( h ) M(h) transition at 0 0 K from singlet to ferromagnetic at the saturation field h s h_{s} .

arxiv-2308-05676.title: Modelling non-local cell-cell adhesion: a multiscale approach
arxiv-2308-05676.creator: Anna Zhigun and Mabel Lizzy Rajendran
arxiv-2308-05676.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Anna Zhigun and Mabel Lizzy Rajendran. Cell-cell adhesion plays a vital role in the development and maintenance of multicellular organisms. One of its functions is regulation of cell migration, such as occurs, e.g. during embryogenesis or in cancer. In this work, we develop a versatile multiscale approach to modelling a moving self-adhesive cell population that combines a careful microscopic description of a deterministic adhesion-driven motion component with an efficient mesoscopic representation of a stochastic velocity-jump process.

arxiv-2407-20556.title: Survey of Design Paradigms for Social Robots
arxiv-2407-20556.creator: Rita Frieske, Xiaoyu Mo, Yini Fang, Jay Nieles, Bertram E. Shi
arxiv-2407-20556.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Rita Frieske, Xiaoyu Mo, Yini Fang, Jay Nieles, Bertram E. Shi. The demand for social robots in fields like healthcare, education, and entertainment increases due to their emotional adaptation features. These robots leverage multimodal communication, incorporating speech, facial expressions, and gestures to enhance user engagement and emotional support. The understanding of design paradigms of social robots is obstructed by the complexity of the system and the necessity to tune it to a specific task.

arxiv-2501-03970.creator: Marcus Appleby, Steven T. Flammia, Gene S. Kopp
arxiv-2501-03970.description: Abstract . We propose a construction of d 2 d^{2} complex equiangular lines in ℂ d \mathbb{C}^{d} , also known as SICs or SIC-POVMs, which were conjectured by Zauner to exist for all d d . The construction gives a putatively complete list of SICs with Weyl–Heisenberg symmetry in all dimensions d > 3 d>3 .

arxiv-2508-17048.title: On the semi-finite vector bundles with connection over Kähler manifolds
arxiv-2508-17048.creator: Sanjay Amrutiya, Indranil Biswas
arxiv-2508-17048.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sanjay Amrutiya, Indranil Biswas. Let X X be a compact connected Kähler manifold. We consider the category 𝒞 EC ​ ( X ) \mathcal{C}^{\mathrm{EC}}(X) of flat holomorphic connections ( E , ∇ E ) (E,\,\nabla^{E}) over X X satisfying the condition that the underlying holomorphic vector bundle E E admits a filtration of holomorphic subbundles preserved by the connection ∇ E \nabla^{E} such that the monodromy of the induced connection on each successive quotient has finite image.

arxiv-2512-02713.creator: Theodoros Aivalis, Iraklis A. Klampanos, Antonis Troumpoukis, Joemon M. Jose
arxiv-2512-02713.description: Abstract . As generative models become powerful, concerns around transparency, accountability, and copyright violations have intensified. Understanding how specific training data contributes to a model’s output is critical. We introduce a framework for interpreting generative outputs through the automatic construction of ontologyaligned knowledge graphs (KGs).

arxiv-2602-12309.title: Resource-Adaptive Teleportation Under Imperfect Entanglement: A Code-Puncturing Framework This work was supported, in part, by the Danish National Research Foundation (DNRF), through the Center CLASSIQUE, grant nr. 187.
arxiv-2602-12309.creator: Mahmoud Saad Abouamer, Jaron Skovsted Gundersen, Søren Pilegaard Rasmussen, Petar Popovski
arxiv-2602-12309.description: Abstract Quantum teleportation is a foundational protocol for sending quantum information through entanglement distribution and classical communication. Assuming ideal classical communication, the reliability of quantum teleportation is limited by the fidelity of the shared EPR pairs. This reliability can be improved through two mechanisms: entanglement purification and quantum error correction (QEC).

count-of-gabalis-1680.description: The 1680 English Count of Gabalis — Villars's Rosicrucian dialogue on elemental spirits; the founding text of occult elemental lore.

pmc-10544305.title: Poor sleep quality and suicidal ideation among pregnant women during COVID-19 in Ethiopia: systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-10544305.creator: Aragaw Asfaw Hasen, Abubeker Alebachew Seid, Ahmed Adem Mohammed
pmc-10544305.description: IntroductionCOVID-19 has profoundly impacted the mental health and well-being of pregnant women worldwide. In Ethiopia, the poor sleep quality and suicidal ideation among pregnant women has increased due to the COVID-19 pandemic. This study aimed to provide comprehensive evidence on the prevalence and associated factors of poor sleep quality and suicidal ideation among pregnant women during COVID-19 in Ethiopia.

pmc-10694958.title: Functionalized MoS2-nanosheets with NIR-Triggered nitric oxide delivery and photothermal activities for synergistic antibacterial and regeneration-promoting therapy
pmc-10694958.creator: Zhixiang Mu, Ting Jin, Tengda Chu, Hongyang Lu, Yuanqi Chen, Sisi Li, BaiRui Zeng, Chen Huang, Kezheng Lei, Xiaojun Cai, Hui Deng, Rongdang Hu
pmc-10694958.description: Bacterial infection in skin and soft tissue has emerged as a critical concern. Overreliance on antibiotic therapy has led to numerous challenges, including the emergence of multidrug-resistant bacteria and adverse drug reactions. It is imperative to develop non-antibiotic treatment strategies that not only exhibit potent antibacterial properties but also promote rapid wound healing and demonstrate biocompatibility.

pmc-11338341.title: Abstract 29: Utilizing Human Umbilical Cord Blood-Derived Exosomes for Inflammation Modulation and Tissue Regeneration: A Promising Therapeutic Strategy
pmc-11338341.creator: Wen-Jui Lee
pmc-11338341.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionUmbilical cord blood (UCB)-derived exosomes, with their cup-shaped morphology and rich cargo of proteins, lipids, and RNAs, are small extracellular vesicles isolated from the umbilical cord blood. Notably, they express specific markers such as CD9, CD63, and CD81.

pmc-11675257.title: The Newborn Screening Programme Revisited: An Expert Opinion on the Challenges of Rett Syndrome
pmc-11675257.creator: Jatinder Singh, Paramala Santosh
pmc-11675257.description: Genomic sequencing has the potential to revolutionise newborn screening (NBS) programmes. In 2024, Genomics England began to recruit for the Generation Study (GS), which uses whole genome sequencing (WGS) to detect genetic changes in 500 genes in more than 200 rare conditions.

pmc-12477801.title: Detection of Genetic Polymorphism in Growth Hormone Receptor Gene and Its Influence on Growth Traits in Kari and Balkhi Sheep
pmc-12477801.creator: Hanan Al‐Khalaifah, Muniza Kiran, Sher Hayat Khan, Ihtesham Ulhaq, Muhammad Ibrahim, Sohail Ahmad, Haris Bilal, Zeng Shenming, Shabana Naz, Rifat Ullah Khan, Ibrahim A Alhidary
pmc-12477801.description: Variations in the growth hormone receptor (GHR) gene influence growth traits, which are important for economic selection in sheep breeding. This study aimed to investigate GHR gene sequence variations and their association with growth traits in two sheep breeds (Kari and Balkhi). A total of 150 animals per breed were included, and blood samples were collected.

pmc-12495791.title: Clinical and radiologic outcomes of minimally invasive locking plate versus screw fixation for displaced intra-articular calcaneal fractures (DIACFs) via sinus tarsi approach: a comparative study
pmc-12495791.creator: Yu-Jui Chang, Chi-Hsiang Hsu, Chien-Chang Liao, Feng-Chih Kuo, Yu-Der Lu, Shan-Ling Hsu, Jen-Hung Chen
pmc-12495791.description: IntroductionThe optimal surgical treatment approach for calcaneal fractures remains controversial. This retrospective comparative study aimed to compare the clinical and radiological outcomes of minimally invasive locking plate fixation with those of screw fixation for displaced intra-articular calcaneus fractures (DIACFs) treated via the sinus tarsi approach (STA).

pmc-12694361.title: Beyond Weight Loss: GLP-1 Usage and Appetite Regulation in the Context of Eating Disorders and Psychosocial Processes
pmc-12694361.creator: Isabel Krug, An Binh Dang, Jade Portingale, Yakun Li, Ying Qing Won, Antonio Cepeda-Benito, Ata Ghaderi
pmc-12694361.description: Background: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) have transformed treatment for higher weight and diabetes. Because they also influence appetite and reward processes, these medications may shape eating behaviours, emotions, and body image, raising new challenges for eating disorder (ED) research and clinical care.

pmc-12988134.title: High Performance Zn–Mn Cement Batteries for the Next Generation of Buildings
pmc-12988134.creator: Zhaolong Liu, Pan Feng, Long Yuan, Ruidan Liu, Xiangyu Meng, Guanghui Tao, Jian Chen, Zaiping Guo, Changwen Miao
pmc-12988134.description: Highlights Conventional cementitious materials were engineered into active cementitious separators (ACSs) that function as capacity boosters rather than passive carriers, significantly enhancing the capacity of Zn–Mn batteries.Continously generated zinc sulfate hydroxide within ACSs acts as an effective proton buffer, suppressing electrolyte acidification and stabilizing birnessite-MnO2 deposition.

pmc-13194695.title: Identification of heat-treated lithic artifacts via quantitative surface gloss characterization
pmc-13194695.creator: Robert Stárek, Yonatan Sahle, Balemwal Atnafu, Martin Moník
pmc-13194695.description: Heat-treated siliceous artifacts from archaeological contexts provide valuable insights into the raw material economy and cognitive prowess of hominins responsible for such a sophisticated and transformative technology. Successful heat treatment induces molecular and structural changes that enhance the mechanical properties of toolstones, ultimately making them more knappable.

pmc-13287751.title: Rovadicitinib, a first-in-class JAK/ROCK inhibitor, in patients with myelofibrosis: a preclinical and phase I study
pmc-13287751.creator: Zefeng Xu, Jinqin Liu, Zhenya Hong, Qingsong Yin, Xuelan Zuo, Qin Wen, Lihong Li, Chunkang Chang, Xin Du, Yiran Wang, Xiaoming Yang, Chenxiao Yang, Haifei Jia, Ling Pan, Zhijian Xiao

pmc-13316390.title: Interpreting Echocardiographic Right Ventricular-Pulmonary Arterial Coupling Indices After Transcatheter Tricuspid Intervention
pmc-13316390.creator: Gianluca Pagnoni, Francesco Marangi, Aurora Vicenzi, Francesca Coppi

pmc-13352776.title: Pre-sowing proline seed priming enhances germination, emergence, and antioxidant capacity of pepper under chilling stress
pmc-13352776.creator: Aygül Karaca
pmc-13352776.description: Low temperature stress is a major limiting factor for seed germination and uniform seedling establishment in warm-season crops, particularly during early sowing periods. Exogenous application of osmo-protective compounds is a promising strategy to alleviate the adverse effects of abiotic stress on seed germination and early seedling establishment.

pmc-13367714.title: Non-native plant integration into plant-insect pollinator networks in urban parks
pmc-13367714.creator: Laura Matas-Granados, Alejandro Trillo, Montserrat Vilà, Vicente Martínez López, Vicente Martínez López, Vicente Martínez López, Vicente Martínez López, Vicente Martínez López, Vicente Martínez López, Vicente Martínez López, Vicente Martínez López, Vicente Martínez López
pmc-13367714.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Pollination sustains biodiversity and ecosystem functioning, yet it is increasingly threatened by biological invasions. Non-native plants frequently integrate into plant-pollinator networks, generating both positive and negative effects on native plants. However, most current knowledge derives from static or short-term studies of communities invaded by a few species, offering limited understanding of plant-pollinator dynamics in systems where many non-native species coexist under favorable environmental conditions.

pmc-13391948.title: Regenerative strategies for surfactant deficiency in neonatal and pediatric lung disease: the role of mesenchymal stem cells and their extracellular vesicles
pmc-13391948.creator: Gloria Pelizzo, Valeria Calcaterra, Maria Antonietta Avanzini, Erika Cordaro, Carlotta Ardenghi, Gianvincenzo Zuccotti
pmc-13391948.description: IntroductionSurfactant deficiency underlies several neonatal and pediatric lung diseases, including respiratory distress syndrome (RDS), bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD), and genetic surfactant disorders. Although advances in neonatal care and surfactant replacement therapy have improved survival in preterm infants, current treatments mainly provide supportive management and do not fully address mechanisms of lung injury and impaired lung development.

pmc-13450582.title: Cytokine release syndrome mimicking drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic syndrome (DRESS) in a patient on blinatumomab therapy
pmc-13450582.creator: Sakshi Chopra, Ysaac Zegeye, Carrie Diamond, Melodi Javid Whitley

pmc-13471486.title: Methodological evaluation of the cross-cultural validation of psychiatric scales in Tunisia: about 43 doctoral theses in medicine
pmc-13471486.creator: Ghassen Kharroubi, Ameni Ben Said, Hadhemi Cherif, Borhen Elloumi, Ines Cherif, Abir Baatout, Wafa Kabtni, Sami Dhif, Hamdi El Kefi, Abdelaziz Oumaya, Jihene Bettaieb
pmc-13471486.description: BackgroundThe cross-cultural validation of psychiatric scales is an essential step to ensure the relevance of assessment tools in specific cultural contexts. In Tunisia, several medical doctoral theses have focused on this field, but their methodological quality has not yet been systematically evaluated.

pmc-13562694.title: Alternatively spliced killer–protector system confers S19-mediated hybrid male sterility in rice
pmc-13562694.creator: Jintao Tang, Huina Wang, Yaoming Feng, Shunmei Li, Ruiying Liu, Zixu Zhang, Shaotong Chen, Shuangchun Li, Xianrong Xie, Heying Li, Zuofeng Zhu, Yao-Guang Liu, Yongyao Xie, Letian Chen
pmc-13562694.description: Hybrid sterility limits the use of strong interspecific heterosis and S19 is a major locus that confers hybrid sterility between Oryza sativa (Asian cultivated rice) and Oryza glaberrima (African cultivated rice). However, the S19 is not yet cloned and its underlying mechanism remains elusive.

pmc-13575067.title: Machine Learning-Guided Survival Prediction and Treatment Sequencing in Advanced Soft Tissue Sarcoma Beyond Second-Line Therapy: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13575067.creator: Michael Hoberger, Dorit Di Gioia, Romy L Zuber, Michael Völkl, Sinan E Güler, Vindi Jurinovic, Markus Albertsmeier, Alexander Klein, Hans Roland Dürr, Nina-Sophie Schmidt–Hegemann, Thomas Knösel, Wolfgang G Kunz, Michael von Bergwelt–Baildon, Lars H Lindner, Anton Burkhard–Meier, Luc M Berclaz
pmc-13575067.description: IntroductionEvidence guiding the optimal sequencing of later-line systemic therapy in advanced soft tissue sarcoma (STS) remains limited. The aim of this study was to identify prognostic factors for overall survival (OS) beyond second-line treatment and to explore therapy sequencing in routine clinical practice.MethodsA total of 90 patients with advanced STS receiving third-line or later systemic therapy were retrospectively analyzed.
